Nonce auth implemented + tested both sides. Swift: SupervisionServiceImpl requires the x-bevel-token metadata header on every RPC, constant-time compared to the --token nonce; unauthenticated RPCError otherwise (5 XCTest cases). C#: HelperClient sends the nonce as gRPC metadata (BuildAuthMetadata), HelperLifecycle passes NonceToken through Connect(). Socket dir hardened to 0700 (HardenSocketDirectory, tested). Peer-UID transport check deferred to bevel-kyf (blocked on grpc-swift-2 handler API; redundant with 0700 dir + nonce for the cross-user threat).

Real trash + trash-undo implemented + tested. IVfsMutator.DeleteAsync now returns the trash location (VfsPath?); LocalFsMutator moves to an injectable trash dir (default ~/.Trash) with collision-free naming, returns null for permanent delete. FileOperationService.ExecuteDeleteAsync records (original,trash) pairs and pushes a TrashUndoEntry; UndoTrashAsync restores. 3 new tests: trash+undo round-trip, permanent-delete-not-undoable, same-name collisions both survive. Helper-based NSFileManager.trashItem (records Finder 'Put Back' metadata) is a future refinement over the ~/.Trash move.
